description: Add a text document to a workspace's company brain as raw material — notes, a transcript, a spec. The nightly job reads it and folds what it says into the pages it belongs on. Push the source rather than writing the page yourself when the material is long or covers several subjects: compressing it across pages is what that job does. For a fact that clearly belongs on one page you have read, edit_wiki_page is more direct.

filename.description: A descriptive filename, with its extension (e.g. 'acme-kickoff-notes.md'). This is how the file is listed and referred to.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: push_wiki_source
